verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a cloud file-conversion SaaS, so asking whether its source is readable under an open license is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows the product's source is published or carries an open license. The official Java SDK is a client library with no stated license, and it is not the product's own source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
